user.title: Domyos Rower
user.description: Pull the handle to wake the rower and enable its Bluetooth, then pick it.

bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name}?

strava_ask.title: Strava upload (optional)
strava_ask.description: TCX, GPX and FIT files are always created when you stop recording. Do you also want a button to send a session to Strava? (Nothing is ever uploaded automatically.) ⚠️ Since June 2026, Strava's API requires a paid Strava subscription: without one, leave this unchecked, the files are still created and you can import them yourself.

strava_app.title: Strava application
strava_app.description:
1. Open https://www.strava.com/settings/api and create your API application (any name/site).
2. Set **localhost** as the "Authorization Callback Domain".
3. Paste the **Client ID** (a number) and the **Client Secret** here.

strava_code.title: Authorise access to Strava

abort.no_devices_found: No Domyos rower found. Wake it up (pull the handle) and make sure a Bluetooth adapter or proxy is in range.

error.invalid_client_id: The client ID must be a number.
error.strava_auth_failed: Strava refused this code. Authorise again (a code works once and expires quickly).

init.title: Session export
init.description: Protocol: "auto" uses the Domyos-specific protocol when the rower has it (like QZ): it puts the console screen in "app" mode (Bluetooth logo, little information). "ftms" forces the standard protocol, like Kinomap: the screen keeps its full display. The change applies after the integration reloads. Folder where the FIT, TCX and GPX files are written. GPX is a GPS format: an indoor session has no position, so every point uses the coordinates below (your Home Assistant home by default).

display_probe.name: Console screen probe (experimental)
display_probe.description: Domyos protocol only. Forces raw bytes of the screen frame for a few seconds to find which byte feeds which field (pace, stroke rate, calories, strokes).

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: "numbered" puts each unknown slot's own byte number in it: what the console shows tells which byte feeds which field.

values.name: Screen bytes
values.description: Bytes 3 to 25 of the screen frame, e.g. {"16": 30}. Values 0 to 255.

odometer_values.name: Odometer bytes
odometer_values.description: Bytes 3 to 25 of the odometer frame.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds during which the frame is resent every second (1 to 120).

console_workout.name: Console workout mode (experimental)
console_workout.description: Domyos protocol only. Sends QZ's "start" or "stop" frames, to see whether the console then shows its own measurements.

options.ftms: FTMS: the console screen stays complete

options.full: Full (like QZ, console in app mode)
options.none: None: send nothing to the console
